tools: Go toolchain, with cgo and a C compiler for the race detector
golangci-lint, at the version CI uses
Python 3.9+ (standard library only) for the new-code coverage script

presentation.name: Gate one Go module for release in a multi-module repository
presentation.summary: Runs the release gates for one Go module that versions and ships on its own: race-enabled tests, overall and new-code coverage, lint scoped to the change, and a version bump that matches the changelog.
benefits: Runs every gate from inside the module, where root-level commands silently skip nested modules
Measures coverage of the changed lines, which overall coverage can hide
Scopes formatting and lint to the change, so pre-existing debt does not bury new findings
Catches a missing version bump that would make a green pull request ship nothing
Fails new code and only warns on legacy gaps, with one line per gate
